description: This file defines utilities for parsing, validating, decoding, and encoding JSON Lines (JSONL) messages specific to the OpenClaw UI protocol, particularly handling version 0.8 message types for communication between server and client. It includes an enum with static methods for processing message data and validation logic.

classes.name: ParsedItem
classes.description: A data structure representing a single parsed JSONL message with its line number and decoded message content.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSONL string into an array of ParsedItem, decoding each line as a JSON object.

methods.name: validateV0_8
methods.description: Validates that each parsed message conforms to version 0.8 protocol, checking allowed message types and structure.

methods.name: decodeMessagesFromJSONL
methods.description: Parses JSONL and validates messages, returning an array of decoded message objects.

methods.name: encodeMessagesJSONArray
methods.description: Encodes an array of messages into a JSON array string.
